data.name: Bladesharp
data.description: (Lesser) You gain proficiency in all slashing martial weapons and the spiked chain. Any slashing weapon or spiked chain you wield gains the deadly weapon special quality (Ultimate Equipment 22) and on a critical hit deals an amount of bleed damage equal to the weapon's critical multiplier -1.
